issues.summary_en: Hopes of US-Iran talks and cancelled strikes triggered an immediate oil price collapse, easing inflation concerns and powering broad US equity gains. Multiple accepted outlets (Reuters, CNBC, AP, Guardian) reported the shift on 2026-08-03, directly explaining the session's risk-on move.
issues.summary_ko: 미-이란 대화 기대와 공습 철회로 유가가 급락하며 인플레이션 우려가 완화, 미국 주가가 광범위하게 상승했다. 로이터·CNBC·AP 등 다수 매체가 8월 3일 이를 보도하며 당일 랠리를 설명한다.
issues.asymmetric_impact_en: NVDA, MSFT, AMZN, META, GOOGL: positive via lower inflation and risk-on flows; PLTR, SNAP: additional positive from same-day earnings beats amplified by macro tailwind
issues.asymmetric_impact_ko: NVDA·MSFT·AMZN·META·GOOGL: 인플레 완화·리스크온으로 긍정; PLTR·SNAP: 동시 실적 호조에 매크로 뒷받침
issues.market_insight_en: Monitor oil price stability and any fresh Middle East headlines; sustained low oil keeps the current equity bid intact.
